l: この前、大きな音がしたんだもん！　きっと何かあったんだよ！
There was a big noise the other day! Something must have happened!
I did, mummy! I could hear them shouting from down the road.
kono mae, ooki na oto gashitandamon! kitto nanika attandayo!
静かになさい、兵隊さんに聞こえるでしょ。
Be quiet. The soldiers will hear you.
Hush now, you didn't hear nothin'.
shizuka ninasai, heitai sanni kiko erudesho.
何なんだよ、あっちにいたおっかねえ兵士たちは…！
What's the deal with those scary soldiers over there...!
Bugger me sidewise... That was the Black Shields!
nani nandayo, atchiniitaokkanee heishi tachiha…!
妙なことに巻き込まれないうちに、さっさとここを離れよう。
Let's get out of here quickly, before we get caught up in something strange.
Come along, now. We'll find another bridge.
myouna kotoni makikoma renaiuchini, sassatokokowo hanare you.
あいつら乱暴しやがって…何様なんだよ…！
Those guys got rough with us... Who do they think they are...!
The bastards are lucky I didn't have my axe...
aitsura ranbou shiyagatte… nanisama nandayo…!

村人たちは 何かに誘われるように《幻想の塔》へ…
あそこには村の東門から行くことができますが…

The villagers went to the Reverie tower, as if drawn by something...
You can reach it from the village's east gate, but...

We have always avoided the tower. People said it was haunted—
that they could hear voices from within.
murabito tachiha nanika ni sasowa reruyouni << gensou no tou >> he… / asokoniha mura no higashimon kara iku kotogadekimasuga…
この人のことは任せとけ
Leave this one to me.
I'll keep an eye on Edda.
kono nin nokotoha makase toke
クライヴ  無茶だけはしてくれるなよ
Clive, just don't do anything reckless.
Which is the best I can do, since I only have the one.
kuraivu mucha dakehashitekurerunayo
革は大事な売り物だ、箱詰めは丁寧に！
This leather's valuable merchandise... pack it in the crates with care!
Careful how you pack that leather. Any creases or scratches will bring down the price.
kawa ha daiji na urimono da, hakozume ha teinei ni!

何だい こいつはまだ商品じゃないぜ
その辺のもんに触んないでおくれよ

What's this now? That's not for sale yet.
Don't go touching the things lying about, please.

These aren't ready for sale, if that's what you're thinking.
And I'll thank you to keep your hands to yourself.
nanda i koitsuhamada shouhin janaize / sono hen nomonni shoku nnaideokureyo

我ら不死鳥教団の本分は隠密活動…
私どもは各地に潜む同胞との定時連絡に向かうところです

Our true calling in the Undying Order is covert work...
We are on our way to make our regular contact with our brethren hidden throughout the land.

Ah, Lord Rosfield. I'm afraid I cannot stay to talk.
I must leave to collect the reports of our spies in the field.
warera fushichou kyoudan no honbun ha onmitsu katsudou… / watashi domoha kakuchi ni hisomu douhou tono teiji renraku ni muka utokorodesu

右筆のブローチがあれば
閣下も我らの同胞を見つけられましょう
With the Scribe's brooch, Your Excellency will be able to find our brethren as well.

Now that you wear the Phoenix Down, our brothers and sisters will no doubt
reveal themselves to you, too.
yuuhitsu no buroochi gaareba / kakka mo warera no douhou wo mitsu keraremashou
それでは――“不死鳥の炎の絶えんことを”
Then..."may the flame of the Phoenix never fade."
Farewell, my lord, and may the firebird's flame burn ever in your heart.
soredehaaa “ fushichou no honoo no tae nkotowo ”

…道を塞いで悪いね
もうすぐ荷を積み終わるからさ

...Sorry for blocking the road.
I'll have the load finished soon.
Sorry, just finishing loading the last of our wares. We'll be out of your way soon enough.
… michi wo fusai de warui ne / mousugu ka wo tsumi owa rukarasa
シリルさんって不思議な人だよな。
Cyril-san is a strange one, isn't he.
That Cyril fellow's an odd fish, don't you think?
shiriru santte fushigi na nin dayona.
どこの出だか知らないけど物知りよねえ。
I don't know where he's from, but he knows a great deal, doesn't he.
Well, scholarly sorts like him always are, aren't they?
dokono ida ka shira naikedo monoshiri yonee.
今日、裏打ちする皮はこれでしまいか…。
So this is the last of the hides to be lined today...
Feel like I've fleshed a hundred skins today...
kyou, urauchi suru kawa hakoredeshimaika….
狩人が綺麗に仕留めてる。丁寧に扱えよ。
The hunter made a clean kill. Handle it with care.
Stay focused, will you? One slip with that scraper and the hunters' hard work'll be for nothing.
kariudo ga kirei ni shitome teru. teinei ni atsukae yo.
この工房に入るときは  静かにしないと駄目だよ
You have to be quiet when you come into this workshop.
You can go inside if you want, but stay quiet...
kono koubou ni iru tokiha shizuka nishinaito dame dayo

出荷する宝石をみがいてるんだ
くれぐれも ソソウのないように

They're polishing gems for shipment.
So be extra careful not to make any mistakes.
Yeah, they're polishing the stones for shipment! Any sudden noises, and they might drop one!
shukka suru houseki womigaiterunda / kureguremo sosou nonaiyouni
この空模様で、獣たちも気が立ってるな…。
With a sky like this, the beasts are on edge too...

Decent quarry's been hard to find
since the skies turned...
kono soramoyou de, kemono tachimo kiga tatsu teruna….
そろそろ狩場を変えるかね。
Maybe it's about time we moved to a different hunting ground.
It has indeed. Can't blame the beasts for being on edge.
sorosoro kariba wo kae rukane.
近くにエーテル溜まりができたそうだよ。
I hear an aetherflood has formed nearby.
An aetherflood, yes—and not a stone's throw away.
chikaku ni eeteru tama rigadekitasoudayo.
怖いねえ、村の中にできなきゃいいけど…。
That's frightening. I hope it doesn't form inside the village...
Oh dear... I hope it doesn't spread...
kowai nee, mura no nakani dekinakyaiikedo….

ここは《教団の館》
我ら不死鳥教団が 今まで集めた資料を保管する場所です

This is the Order's Hall.
It is where our Undying Order keeps all the records we have gathered to date.
This is the Requietory. An archive where we of the Undying collect and collate our findings.
kokoha << kyoudan no kan >> / warera fushichou kyoudan ga imamade atsume ta shiryou wo hokan suru basho desu

ここにある雑多な断片は
いつかアルテマの真実につながると信じております

I believe the scattered fragments here
will one day lead to the truth of Ultima.

Fragments of Ultima's true nature surely lie buried within these pages—
we have only to unearth them.
kokoniaru zatta na danpen ha / itsuka arutema no shinjitsu nitsunagaruto shinji teorimasu
変なお空…怖いね…。
What a strange sky... It's frightening...

Why won't the sky go back to how it was?
I don't like it...
henna o sora… kowai ne….
ばあちゃんも、こんな空見たことないよ…。
Even Grandma has never seen a sky like this...
Nor do I, dearie. In all my long years, I've never seen such a thing.
baachanmo, konna sora mita kotonaiyo….
カンベルがアカシアに襲われてるなんて。
To think Kanver is being attacked by the Akashic.
The Free Cities under siege... Who'd've thought it?
kanberu ga akashia ni osowa reterunante.
教えてくれたシリルさんに感謝しなきゃ…。
We have to thank Cyril-san for telling us...
Master Cyril, luckily. And thank goodness he told us before we set out.
oshie tekureta shiriru sanni kanshashi nakya….

そのブローチ…閣下でいらっしゃいますね
この村において 狩人の役割は非常に重要なのですよ

That brooch... So it is Your Excellency.
In this village, the hunter's role is a very important one, you see.

That mark... You must be Lord Rosfield. A pleasure to make your acquaintance, my lord.
I too am a member of the cause...though I spend most of my time hunting.
sono buroochi… kakka deirasshaimasune / kono mura nioite kariudo no yakuwari ha hijouni juuyouna nodesuyo

仕留めた獲物の血肉が皆の食料に
皮や骨が 職人の手で売り物となりますゆえ…

The flesh and blood of the beasts we bring down become food for everyone,
and the hides and bones become wares to sell in the craftsmen's hands...

For the good of the village, you understand. The soil is poor here, so the people sup mostly on
meat and blood. The hides, meanwhile, they make into leather—and then into gil.
shitome ta emono no ketsuniku ga mina no shokuryou ni / kawa ya hone ga shokunin no tede urimono tonarimasuyue…

あっちに見たことない化け物が出てきやがったんだ
これじゃどこにも商売に行けないぜ…

A monster I've never seen before has come out over that way.
At this rate we can't go anywhere to trade...

There are horrible beasts down that way. Ashen terrors who'll kill you as soon as look at you.
Would that I had the strength to kill them first...
atchini mita kotonai bakemono ga dete kiyagattanda / korejadokonimo shoubai ni ike naize…

我ら不死鳥教団の同胞は
多くが市井に隠れ潜んでおります

Many of our brethren in the Undying Order
live hidden among the common folk.
The greater number of our order live among the masses, hidden in plain sight.
warera fushichou kyoudan no douhou ha / ooku ga shisei ni kakure hison deorimasu

このタボールでも村人に紛れておりますゆえ
見つけても その素性はご内密に

Here in Tabor as well, they live among the villagers,
so even if you find one, keep their true identity secret.

Even here in Tabor, our brothers and sisters pose as commonfolk.
If any should reveal themselves to you, I beg you keep their true identities secret.
kono tabooru demo murabito ni magire teorimasuyue / mitsu ketemo sono sujou hago naimitsu ni

この村の石碑は 何百年も前からあったという
そしていつしか 村になくてはならないものとなった

They say this village's stone monument has stood here for hundreds of years.
And in time it became something the village could not do without.

If the people of Tabor had not built those domes above the stones to protect them from
the elements, the engravings would soon have been lost.
kono mura no sekihi ha nanbyakunen mo zenka raattatoiu / soshiteitsushika mura ninakutehanaranaimonotonatta

だから 大切な石碑が雨で朽ちぬよう
村人たちがあとから丸屋根をつくったのだよ

So that the precious monument would not rot away in the rain,
the villagers later built a round roof over it.
It just goes to show how important they must be to the people of the village.
dakara taisetsu na sekihi ga ame de kuchi nuyou / murabito tachigaatokara maruyane wotsukuttanodayo

おや 旅人かい？
このタボールに来るなんて物好きだね

Oh, a traveler, are you?
Coming to Tabor... you're a curious one.
Welcome, travelers. We don't get many visitors here in Tabor.
oya tabibito kai？ / kono tabooru ni kuru nante monozuki dane

これは閣下…右筆は中におります
ご用件があれば 何なりと

Ah, Your Excellency... The Scribe is within.
If you have need of anything, please say so.
The Bearer of the Burning Quill is within, my lord. Prithee, enter.
koreha kakka… yuuhitsu ha nakani orimasu / go youken gaareba nani narito
あんたらのおかげで薬や外の噂が手に入る。とても助かるよ。
Thanks to you lot, we get medicine and news from outside. It's a great help.
You have my thanks. Without your medicines and your wisdom, Tabor would be but a shadow of itself.
antaranookagede kusuri ya soto no uwasa ga teniiru. totemo tasuka ruyo.
我々を村においていただいているんです…。当然ですよ、村長。
It is you who allow us to remain in the village... It is only natural, Mayor.
It is the least we can do in return for your generous hospitality, my lord.
wareware wo mura nioiteitadaiteirundesu…. touzen desuyo, sonchou.
今日もいい出来だな！　この調子でどんどん毛皮を仕上げてくれ！
Good work again today! Keep this up and finish up plenty of pelts!
Yes, the finish is exquisite! These will make m—us rich! Rich, I tell you!
kyou moii deki dana! kono choushi dedondon kegawa wo shiage tekure!

悪いけど うちの革はお得意様にしか売らないんだ
あんたがどんな金持ちでも 取引はできないよ

Sorry, but we only sell our leather to our regular customers.
However rich you may be, we can't do business with you.

Forgive me, traveler, but no matter how deep your pockets might be,
we only sell to trusted patrons. I do hope you've not had a wasted journey.
warui kedo uchino kawa hao tokui youni shika ura nainda / antagadonna kanemochi demo torihiki hadekinaiyo
お若いの  こんなちっぽけな村に何の用だね
What business does a young one like you have in a tiny village like this?
What brings you to our humble village, young man?
o wakai no konnachippokena mura ni nanno you dane

歩き回っても構わんが
皆の仕事の邪魔はしないでおくれよ

You can walk around all you like,
but don't get in the way of everyone's work.
If it's our artisans you're here to see, then please—but do try not to interrupt their work.
aruki mawatsu temo kamawa nga / mina no shigoto no jama hashinaideokureyo
村長、持病がよくなったって。
I hear the Mayor's old ailment has gotten better.
Have you noticed the elder has been coughing less of late?
sonchou, jibyou gayokunattatte.
シリルさんから、いい薬をもらったようだ。
Seems he got some good medicine from Cyril-san.
Yes, I hear Master Cyril drew up a new tonic for him.
shiriru sankara, ii kusuri womorattayouda.

…薬で皮の下処理をしてるんだ
危ないから 下がっててくれるかい

...We treat the hides with chemicals.
It's dangerous, so would you step back?
Stand back, friend. You don't want to get this stuff on you, believe me.
… kusuri de kawa no shita shori woshiterunda / abunai kara saga ttetekurerukai
革の切れ端を持ってきたぞ。
I've brought you some leather scraps.
Here's the scraps you were after.
kawa no kirehashi wo motsu tekitazo.
助かるよ、宝石磨きはこいつでなくちゃ。
That's a huge help. You can't polish gems without this stuff.
Thanks. Can't do without leather if I'm to polish these stones.
tasuka ruyo, houseki migaki hakoitsudenakucha.
おばさん、いい砥石を持ってないか？
Auntie, you wouldn't have a good whetstone on you?
You wouldn't happen to have a decent whetstone in there, would you, madam?
obasan, ii toishi wo motsu tenaika？
これを持っておいき。宝石クズも混じってるから剣を研ぐにはもってこいさ。
Take this with you. There's gem scrap mixed in, so it's just the thing for sharpening a sword.
I'm sure I can find you something. All of these stones have a good bit of diamond dust in them—that'll see your sword sharp, alright.
korewo motsu teoiki. houseki kuzu mo maji tterukara tsurugi wo togu nihamottekoisa.
狩人さん、いつもお肉をありがとう！
Hunter-san, thanks for the meat, always!
Thank you for the deer leg, mister! Mummy made a pottage from it!
kariudo san, itsumoo niku woarigatou!
また大きな獲物を仕留めてくるからな。
I'll bring down another big one for you.
Sounds delicious. Perhaps she'll invite me round to try it next time.
mata ooki na emono wo shitome tekurukarana.
この宝石はカンベル、この箱はダリミル…。
This gem's from Kanver, and this box from Dalimil...
So it's these stones to Kanver, and the rest of the boxes to Dalimil...
kono houseki ha kanberu, kono hako ha darimiru….

…閣下に拝謁いたします
私も教団の一翼 ここでは革職人を務めております

...I am honored to be granted audience, Your Excellency.
I too am of the order; here I serve as a leatherworker.

Blessings of the Phoenix be upon you, Lord Rosfield. I too serve His Grace...
albeit in the role of a humble tanner.
… kakka ni haietsu itashimasu / watashi mo kyoudan no ichiyoku kokodeha kakushoku nin wo tsutome teorimasu

この村は 狩人と職人の村…
革や宝石の取引で生計を立てているのですよ

This village is a village of hunters and craftsmen...
We make our living trading in leather and gems.

Tabor's leather is famed throughout the realm. My task is to see that the craft thrives,
and the village with it—in order that my brothers and sisters might remain well guarded and fed.
kono mura ha kariudo to shokunin no mura… / kawa ya houseki no torihiki de seikei wo tate teirunodesuyo
いい革だ…高く売れておくれよ…。
Good leather... fetch a high price, now...
Hm. Not a scratch on them. These hides'll fetch a good price.
ii kawa da… takaku ure teokureyo….
その革の靴、履き心地はどうだい？
How do those leather shoes feel on your feet?
How are those new boots treating you?
sono kawa no kutsu, haki kokochi hadoudai？
最高だ、さすがうちの村の革だな！
They're the best... just what you'd expect from our village's leather!
They're fantastic! Soft as Phoenix down, but tough as boiled 'bo!
saikou da, sasugauchino mura no kawa dana!

閣下のご助力により クジェトフの調査が進んだとか
教団の一翼として 厚く御礼申し上げます

I hear that thanks to Your Excellency's assistance, the investigation of Kretov has advanced.
As one of the order, I offer you my profound thanks.
I thank you for assisting my brothers and sisters with the survey in Kretov, my lord.
kakka nogo joryoku niyori kujietofu no chousa ga susun datoka / kyoudan no ichiyoku toshite atsuku oreimoushi age masu

かの地の遺物は 極めて高度な魔法で動いていたようです
調査次第では アルテマに対する一助となるやもしれませぬ

The relics of that land appear to have been driven by exceedingly advanced magic.
Depending on what the investigation finds, they may prove of some aid against Ultima.

There are magicks beyond mortal ken hidden among those ruins and others like them.
If we can learn their secrets, mayhap we can use them to resist Ultima's might.
kano chi no ibutsu ha kiwame te koudo na mahou de ugoi teitayoudesu / chousa shidai deha arutema ni taisuru ichijo tonaruyamoshiremasenu

我々不死鳥教団が 各地でアルテマのことを調べているように
この世界には いくつもの暗躍する集団があるといいます

Just as we of the Undying Order search out Ultima in every land,
so they say this world holds any number of factions moving in the shadows.

The Undying are not the only secret fellowship in this realm, you know.
There are others, each working for their own ends.
wareware fushichou kyoudan ga kakuchi de arutema nokotowo shirabe teiruyouni / kono sekai niha ikutsumono anyaku suru shuudan gaarutoiimasu

そのうちのひとつに かつて クリスタルを介さず
魔法を使おうとした者たちがいたとか

Among them were once those who sought to wield magic
without the intercession of a Crystal, or so it is said.
Why, not so very long ago, a society committed to discovering how one might cast magicks without a catalyst was found to be operating throughout Valisthea.
sonouchinohitotsuni katsute kurisutaru wo kaisa zu / mahou wo tsukao utoshita mono tachigaitatoka

結局 自然の摂理に抗うことができなかった彼らは
詐欺師と蔑まれ ヴァリスゼアから追放されたようですがね

In the end they could not defy the laws of nature, and were scorned as frauds
and banished from Valisthea, it seems.

They were denounced as heretics, rooted out, and driven from our shores,
never to be seen again.
kekkyoku shizen no setsuri ni aragau kotogadekinakatta karera ha / sagishi to sagesuma re varisuzea kara tsuihou saretayoudesugane

空に浮かぶ黒きものの報せは こちらにも入っております
右筆の指示のもと 急ぎ詳細を調査中にございます

Word of the black thing floating in the sky has reached us as well.
Under the Scribe's direction, we are investigating the details with all haste.

News has reached us of the black bulk that soars over the strait.
Lord Cyril has ordered our survey teams to investigate it forthwith.
sora ni uka bu kuroki monono shirase ha kochiranimo itsutsu teorimasu / yuuhitsu no shiji nomoto isogi shousai wo chousachuu nigozaimasu

この戦がいかなる終わりを迎えようと 我らは祈り続けます
“不死鳥の炎の絶えんことを”…どうぞ閣下もご無事で

Whatever end this war may come to, we shall go on praying.
"May the flame of the Phoenix never fade"... And may you be safe, Your Excellency.

<scale=0.93>It would seem that your battle is coming to a head, my lord. I pray that you and your brother will emerge victorious. May the firebird's flame burn ever in your hearts...and guide you back home safely.<scale>
kono sen gaikanaru owari wo mukae youto warera ha inori tsuzuke masu / “ fushichou no honoo no tae nkotowo ”… douzo kakka mogo buji de

《教団の館》へようこそ 閣下
ゴディサ卿は 逗留中の宿場へお帰りになりました

Welcome to the Order's Hall, Your Excellency.
Lady Goditha has returned to the inn where she was staying.

Welcome to the Requietory, my lord. If you are looking for Lady Goditha,
she has returned to her lodgings.
<< kyoudan no kan >> heyoukoso kakka / godisa kyou ha touryuu nakano shukuba heo kaeri ninarimashita

閣下とジョシュア様へ 言伝を預かっております
“おふたりの絆をいつも想っています”と…

I have been entrusted with a message for Your Excellency and Joshua-sama.
"I think always of the bond between the two of you"...

But she bade me give you and His Grace a message: "Your father lives on in you.
Trust in him, and in each other."
kakka to joshua sama he kotozute wo azuka tteorimasu / “ ofutarino kizuna woitsumo omotsu teimasu ” to…

第三席が遺した調査報告書には 風の大陸に絶えて久しい
マリアス教の伝承が記されていました
The investigative report left behind by the Third Seat recorded the traditions of the Circle of Malius, which had long since died out on the Wind Continent.

The Third Chair's report is a treasure trove of information regarding
the beliefs and traditions of the Circle of Malius.
daisan seki ga nokoshi ta chousahoukoku kaki niha kaze no tairiku ni tae te hisashii / mariasu kyou no denshou ga shirusa reteimashita

我らの敵アルテマの思惑に近づく 大変意義ある資料でした
彼は命をかけるにふさわしい務めを果たしたのです

It was a document of great significance, one that brings us closer to the designs of our enemy Ultima.
He fulfilled a duty worthy of staking his life on.

Considering the Circle's connections to Ultima, it will surely be an invaluable resource
in divining his true nature. Our brother did his duty well.
warera no teki arutema no omowaku ni chikazu ku taihen igi aru shiryou deshita / kareha inochi wokakerunifusawashii tsutome wo hata shitanodesu

おや あんた…前もうちの村に来なかったかい？
どこも大変だってのに こんなところまでよく来るねえ…

Oh, you... didn't you come to our village once before?
Things are hard everywhere, yet you come all the way out here...

<scale=0.96>You've been here before, haven't you? Aye, I remember—it was back in the day when we only had to worry about the blackened skies and the benighted earth, and not this new evil in between!<scale>
oya anta… mae mouchino mura ni kona kattakai？ / dokomo taihen dattenoni konnatokoromadeyoku kuru nee…

おっと あんた
その先の崖には気をつけろよ

Whoa there, you.
Mind the cliff past here.
Watch it, stranger. There's a fault up ahead.
otto anta / sono sakino gake niha kiwo tsukeroyo
落っこちたら登ってこれないぜ
Fall off that, and you won't be climbing back up.
Take a look if you want, but slip and you won't be coming back.
otsu kochitara nobotsu tekorenaize
